title: FairFare: Ride-Share Surge Analyzer
context: Ride-hailing apps raise prices when demand outstrips drivers. Analysts check when surges happen and whether they are fair.
input: Requests and available drivers per minute per zone; shift lengths.

milestones.title: Duplicate ride requests
milestones.requirement: Rider ids that requested twice within a minute (count array).

milestones.title: Shift plans
milestones.requirement: Ordered ways to cover a 10-hour day with 2-, 3- and 4-hour shifts (memoised recursion).

milestones.title: Worst shortage stretch
milestones.requirement: Maximum run of (requests − drivers): the most painful surge.

milestones.title: Shortest stretch reaching 50 rides
milestones.requirement: Minimum window with requests ≥ target (positive counts).

milestones.title: Driver rate needed
milestones.requirement: Minimum rides per hour per driver so every zone clears within 8 hours.

milestones.title: Surge cap
milestones.requirement: Rolling maximum surge multiplier over 3 intervals (deque).
